translated_title: Michoacán to Distribute 10,000 Artisanal Guitars in Secondary Schools to Boost Arts Education
original_title: Michoacán distribuirá 10 mil guitarras artesanales en secundarias para impulsar la educación artística
author: Ernesto Martínez Elorriaga
meta_description: Part of the Michoacán Plan for Peace and Justice, the 10-million-peso program aids Paracho's 15 guitar workshops and reaches 180,000 students.
